sequence: add Pd/C (10 wt% catalyst grade) and stir under an H2 balloon at room temperature for 48 h
filter through Celite, elute with EtOAc, concentrate
silica gel chromatography with PE/EtOAc 5:1-2:1 to give the free-acid intermediate
dissolve the intermediate in CH2Cl2 (5 mL), cool to 0 °C, add DCC (2.0 equiv), DMAP (2.0 equiv), and EtOH (2 mL)
move to room temperature and stir overnight
after TLC completion, evaporate and purify by column chromatography with PE/EtOAc 15:1-9:1 to give 5
